summary_sentences: The petitioner was arrested on 14 March 2024 under Sections 420 and 468 of the IPC.
The prosecution alleges misappropriation of funds amounting to Rs. 12.4 lakh.
The petitioner has no prior criminal record and has cooperated with the investigation.
The court finds the custody period disproportionate to the alleged offence's severity.
Bail is granted subject to a personal bond and surrender of the passport.
